content.title: Game Recommendations
content.body:
These games offer diverse genres and themes, suitable for both casual and dedicated gaming sessions.

## Recommended Games
- **Hades**: Roguelike masterpiece with tight combat, incredible character work, and Greek mythology brought brilliantly to life.
- **Outer Wilds**: Unique space exploration game built around curiosity and discovery with an unforgettable time loop mechanic.
- **Celeste**: Challenging platformer with gorgeous pixel art that weaves mental health themes into both story and gameplay.
